title: LangGraph
summary: Cyclic stateful multi-agent orchestration framework built by LangChain.
description: LangGraph is a library for building stateful, multi-actor applications with LLMs, used to create agent and multi-agent workflows. Unlike DAG frameworks, LangGraph supports cyclic graphs, persistent state checkpoints, human-in-the-loop approvals, and fine-grained agent coordination.
keyFeatures: Cyclic execution graphs for iterative agent reasoning
Built-in state persistence and time-travel debugging
Human-in-the-loop breakpoint controls
Multi-agent team delegation and routing

title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
summary: An open standard created by Anthropic for connecting AI models to tools and data sources.
description: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that enables developers to build secure, two-way connections between AI applications and data sources or external tools. MCP replaces fragmented custom integrations with a unified client-server architecture.
keyFeatures: Standardized client-server protocol over STDIO and SSE
Prompt templates, resource subscription, and tool invocation
Interoperable ecosystem across Claude Desktop, Cursor, and custom clients
Strong security boundaries for enterprise tool execution

title: Groq LPU Inference Engine
summary: Ultra-low latency Language Processing Unit hardware for real-time agent responses.
description: Groq provides ultra-high-speed inference for open LLMs (Llama 3, Mixtral) using custom-built LPU (Language Processing Unit) hardware. Groq enables real-time sub-second multi-turn agent loops necessary for voice AI and agentic reasoning cascades.
keyFeatures: Sub-100ms time-to-first-token inference speed
500+ tokens per second on open models
Standard OpenAI API client compatibility
Deterministic predictable execution latency

title: Cursor AI IDE
summary: AI-native code editor optimized for agentic code edits and multi-file reasoning.
description: Cursor is a fork of VS Code built from the ground up for AI-driven software development. Features include multi-file codebase indexing, Shadow Workspace agent execution, terminal auto-healing, and integrated agentic code editing.
keyFeatures: Codebase indexing via fast vector search & symbol graph
Agentic multi-file code editing via Composer
Native terminal command execution and error auto-fix
Custom system prompt rules and project-level context

title: Neo4j Graph Database
summary: Enterprise graph database for GraphRAG and long-term agent relational memory.
description: Neo4j provides high-performance graph database storage essential for GraphRAG (Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and knowledge graph agent memory. Enables autonomous agents to model dynamic real-world entity relationships and temporal memory.
keyFeatures: Cypher query language for complex graph traversals
Vector search indexing combined with graph traversal
Enterprise ACID compliance and transaction durability
Native integrations with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Haystack

title: PyTorch 2.x
summary: The foundational deep learning framework powering custom LLM training & fine-tuning.
description: PyTorch is the premier open-source machine learning framework created by Meta AI. Modern agent developer tools rely on PyTorch for model fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), custom agent reward modeling, reinforcement learning from human/AI feedback (RLHF/RLAIF), and tensor compute.
keyFeatures: Dynamic computation graph (`torch.compile`) for max efficiency
Comprehensive GPU/TPU acceleration and distributed training
Vast ecosystem including Hugging Face, vLLM, and Deepspeed
TorchDynamo and Inductor compilation engines

title: ChromaDB / Qdrant Vector Stores
summary: High-speed semantic search databases for agent long-term vector memory.
description: Vector databases store document embeddings and agent conversation histories. They enable semantic retrieval, context window management, and long-term episodic memory for autonomous agents.
keyFeatures: Sub-millisecond approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search
Payload filtering and multi-tenant isolation
In-memory local mode and cloud distributed modes
Hybrid dense-sparse retrieval capabilities

title: Docker Sandboxes
summary: Isolated containerized execution environments for secure untrusted agent code execution.
description: Autonomous agents frequently generate and execute code (Bash, Python). Docker containers provide isolated, sandboxed environments with strict resource limits, preventing unsafe modifications to host systems.
keyFeatures: Isolated filesystem, networking, and CPU/RAM quotas
Container state snapshots and fast reset capabilities
REST API execution control via Docker Engine API
Security hardening with seccomp and read-only rootfs

title: GitHub Codespaces
summary: Cloud-hosted development environments for cloud agent deployment and collaboration.
description: GitHub Codespaces delivers instant, cloud-hosted dev environments pre-configured with GPU acceleration, devcontainers, and secret management. Perfect for running background AI agents and remote multi-developer collaboration.
keyFeatures: Devcontainer specification compliance
Instant setup with pre-baked dependencies and extension stacks
Port forwarding and web preview capabilities
Seamless integration with GitHub actions and AI runners

specs.primaryUse: Cloud Dev Environments for AI Agents

title: Repomix (Repo2Text)
summary: Tool that packs entire code repositories into a single LLM-friendly structured context file.
description: Repomix (formerly Repository-to-Text) packs an entire project repository into a clean, structured XML or Markdown file formatted specifically for LLM context windows, complete with token counting and security secret scanning.
keyFeatures: Automatic token counting for Claude, OpenAI, and Llama contexts
Built-in secret masking and sensitive file filtering
Tree structure representation and syntax highlighting
CLI, NPX, and library execution interfaces
